findings_and_connected_existing.observation: The 64-bit-only test calculates fit before growth and asserts fixture capacities and byte lengths. Current fixture explicitly expects 4294967295 -> 0 capacity/0 bytes and 4294967296 or 4294967312 -> retained 16 capacity/1024 bytes. The count type stores usize; fit truncates to u32 and next-power-of-two capacity truncates to u32. On a 64-bit host these expectations encode the same pre-existing narrowing behavior, not a safe-allocation or admission proof. The fixture is source text, not a run.
